0.original: Your work is far from finished, as Conrad knows.

24.original: Search the Fringes for remnants of the imperial army.

48.original: Did you see that, A'aba, Aulie? We did it!

49.original: <pant> <pant> For a moment there, I didn't think I could do it...but then I did!

50.original: One step at a time, one step at a time. Until we're on Zenos's doorstep!

51.original: Ssso, you are indeed everything they sssay. The ssstuff of legends...

52.original: There's still a chance that some imperials are holed up inside the castellum. We'll need to search it top to bottom to be sure it's safe.

53.original: In the meantime, I want you to rendezvous with the main host. Keep your weapons at the ready─there's a chance you might come face<hex:021F0103>to<hex:021F0103>face with soldiers on the run en route.

54.original: On second thought, it might be prudent for you to do a preemptive sweep of the region for soldiers that have gone to ground. We shouldn't afford them any time to regroup and launch a counterattack.

55.original: When you've judged your work to be done, report to General Aldynn in Bittermill.

56.original: Just because we've won doesn't mean it's over yet. There're still enemies about, and a panicked soldier can kill you just as quick as a cool-headed one.

59.original: Sod this! I'm not dying today!

60.original: The Bull of Ala Mhigo has done it again. His assessment of Fordola's response was without error.

61.original: It's a good thing M'naago got the flag flying when she did. Any longer and those imperials might have had us at their mercy...

63.original: Good, good. The fighting has died down here too, as you can see.

64.original: Pipin left but a moment ago with a contingent of troops to occupy Velodyna. If and when the imperials return, they'll find us dug in behind their own walls.

65.original: I could not have hoped for a better outcome, General. Splendidly done.

66.original: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. It'll take more than one castellum to turn the tide.

67.original: My men and I will deal with the remaining enemy forces. Scions, I bid you return to Commander Kemp and his men.

68.original: Delight not overmuch in victory─not when there are battles left to fight...

69.original: Our work here is finished. Our Resistance allies are waiting.

70.original: From a stone bridge to a massive fortress... Garlean engineering never ceases to impress.

71.original: Now that we have taken control of Velodyna, there's nothing stopping us from marching east towards the Peaks.

72.original: If you're looking for Arenvald, I think he's with Pipin, searching the castellum for any remaining soldiers.

73.original: Velodyna belongs to the Alliance and the Resistance now. You may be assured that the imperials will never hold it again!

74.original: Back so soon? I suppose the General and his men had matters well in hand.

75.original: The vice marshal and his men showed up not long after you left. If the gods are good, there'll be no one left to fight...
